notes.title: Virtual Battlegrounds Forever
notes.content:
Hello Warriors!

This is a final update and goodbye from the development team at CyberDream. Creating Virtual Battlegrounds with our community has been one of the greatest pleasures of my and our teams’ life. I am sorry to those of you whom had hoped that Virtual Battlegrounds could be more. But I am eternally grateful for the experiences we’ve had building and playing this game together. Battle on Warriors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/dc53ad797d2df5652834edd2f5fcf362b7d3473f.jpg[/img]

If you’re a developer or are interested in learning about the development of Virtual Battlegrounds I encourage you to read this blog post here where I did a deep dive postmortem. It was quite the epic journey.

https://www.reddit.com/r/gamedev/comments/wqa2ko/the_mystical_journeys_of_an_indie_game_developer/

UPDATE VERSION 0.7.4 Hound

On a positive note we do have a final update to share with you all. Frankly speaking we’ve been sitting on this update for some time in hopes that we could return to Virtual Battlegrounds development and add more content before releasing it, but unfortunately we've had to move onto other projects so this update isn't as dense as we'd have liked. It does have a large rolodex of bug fixes, quality of life features and a new tutorial to help with onboarding.

Tutorial Update

One of the biggest issues we had identified around Christmas was new player bounce rate. We noticed many players didn’t make it through the tutorial. Because of this we decided to double down on our tutorial. Our tutorial has a over eighty quality of life improvements that make it much more approachable for a fresh experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/575212178128b60585ad6afdaa05cf1af544c178.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/89215f2b799344224cee7b1fdac92a03df0e6851.gif[/img]

Bug Fixes / Quality of Life changes
* Improved Vegetation Performance
* Door LOD pop in bugs across the map
* Fixed bug where players clip through shipping container
* Smoothed part of Mount Ostenbirk to make it more traversable.
* Updated new pop up UI
* Fixed some vegetation tree visual inconsistencies with billboarding
* Fixed the pumpkin skin
* Removed vegetation inside of houses
* Updated wrist watcher shader to look more natural with highlights overlaid
* Fixed Sam the Robot Vos in lobby
* Improved holosight smoothing
* Fixed players bad spawning in trees in warmup mode
* Made it easier to cock the P90
* First time users load directly into the tutorial
* Fixed column of skins being unselectable
* Fixed issues with dropping ammo out of backpack in lobby hovering after start
* Fixed up issue with ammo not going in backpack
* Improved UX / UI for zipline interaction
* Made backpack handling a bit easier to navigate
* Fixed bug where throwing a basketball played a SFX when it should not
* Players are forcibly ejected from helicopter earlier to avoid Ocean outings
* Players deep in the ocean are teleported inland.
* Smoothed hand movement for very shaky hands
* Fixed bug with grip interaction selected for the backpack
* AI land at a time closer to the player landing in battle royale mode
* VO Lobby Timer countdown improved
* Fixed some longstanding bugs with Virtual Desktop
* Disabled body UI while holding backpack
* Added lights to HELO to better indicate UX for jumping
* Fixed some bugs with press to crouch.
* About fifty other minor fixes and QoL improvements.


Final Play Session

Warriors! We are going to have one last developer organized play session together this Saturday at 12PM ET / 4PM UTC. Come hang with the developers in game.

notes.title: Season 2 - December 17th
notes.content:
Hello [b]Warriors![/b]

We're excited to share with you the [b]biggest update since the launch of our game [/b]back in April coming [b]December 17th.[/b]

[h2]Season 2 - Official Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=C8Gj-cyFyKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Season 2 - Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/777247b756de85aa67a141d6039dd26b308854a0.png[/img]

We've got a lot of[b] BIG updates[/b] to share with you about season two. They include [b]warehouse district,[/b] [b]new lobby system[/b], [b]shotguns[/b], [b]weather modes[/b], [b]art overhaul[/b], [b]new killroom[/b],[b] new gun range [/b]and a plethora of minor improvements including [b]bug fixes[/b], [b]optimizations[/b], [b]minor features[/b] and [b]design tweaks[/b].

[h2]Warehouse District
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/957338a704fd0e849c6cf072195ff947e0b8651e.png[/img]

Welcome to the [b]warehouse district![/b] It's our [b]biggest [/b]and [b]most thoughtfully designed[/b] location yet. Zipline across forklifts, traverse the inner workings of multi floor store rooms, or take cover behind storage containers.

[h2]Pump Shotgun[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/e4ec420f8ec3ae8d29de37a26b443f8dbbd8f12a.png[/img]

We built a[b] new gun handling system[/b] for the [b]pump shotgun[/b] with [b]bullet spray, pumpable rounds, and loadable shells.[/b] Expect new shotguns to start popping up all of the map. The new king of close corridor action.

[h2]Randomized weather System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/b2f7f69467c66bc90a1fb4c1f9d8027a1e8c2f72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/37414d2d70d5a97b6766bd33231533c93b13eb7d.png[/img]

We built a number of weather conditions to play in VBG. [b]Original version, overcast, thunderstorm, moonlight, sunny day, and red sun.[/b] Each time you start a match a weather version will be chosen at random giving the game a unique feel. [b]Let us know your favorite![/b]

[h2]New Lobby System
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/0e2f98031dc84be24c148db910b0ec0c10ed05a0.png[/img]

In addition to a whole new look to the lobby with [b]custom banners[/b] that [b]showcase the seasons legends and warriors![/b] We built a lobby system that should make it much [b]easier [/b]to quickly[b] hop into the games and find players.[/b] One of the biggest issues we've felt the game has had was its lobby system, it took too long to get games going and finding other players was difficult. With this new system queue up the second you want to for a match or hang out in the public lobby room until you get a group going and then queue up.

[h2]New Kill Room[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/0fa9f2651b3c001b11f9127c11965cbcf98a0b62.png[/img]

We've all had a blast getting kills in the killroom while waiting on a match. With the new lobby and lobby system you can chill out now and hop onto the red or blue side for a few quick kills whenever you want. No more being forced to wait in the killroom. [b]This Kill Room is BIG! [/b]Big enough for some team battles. That or skip this portion of the game entirely and go straight to the battlegrounds. [b]Your choice warrior.[/b]
[h2]
Multiplayer Gun Range
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/5b63601cfdf92760d1cf12509c4d0d7d27ad09ae.png[/img]

By default Virtual Battlegrounds is [b]always multiplayer [/b]now outside of private games and your [b]private room. [/b]As soon as you step into the gun range expect to test your skills against friends or strangers!

[h2]Developer Stream [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/eb2493030590d346961e630aca87cc77515d9547.png[/img]

Expect our creative director [b]Sean Pinnock[/b] to be [b]streaming today[/b] 12/11/20 [b]5PM ET[/b]  or [b]10PM UTC [/b] on our twitch channel. He'll be give us the latest on Virtual Battlegrounds and Season two. Pop in for any questions you might have.

[b]Twitch channel link:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr]https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr[/url]

[h2]Full Changelist[/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Warehouse District
[*] Pump Shotguns
[*] Random weather settings
[*] Art overhaul
[*] New Lobby System
[*] New Kill Room
[*] Multiplayer gun range
[/list]

[b]New minor features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added join game functionality to public lobby area.
[*] Added banners to the public lobby that showcase warriors and legends of that season.
[*] Added advanced vegetation option that adds a lot more detail to the map.
[*] Added skins for players who hit legend and warrior in season one.
[*] Added zone hit visual effect.
[*] Added the ability to climb any part of a tree including all of their branches.
[*] Replaced all major UI elements with new ones.
[/list]

[b]Design Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Made matches 30% faster by decreasing wait time between zones and increasing zone close speed.
[*] Reduced max queue time to 3 minutes.
[*] Made parachute auto deploy if you get close and don't pull the chute. No more splats. Also adding an option to remove this feature so you can pull a chute at your discretion.
[*] Made trigger mode on by default for new players.
[*] Updated holographic and wrist watch maps to include new locations.
[*] Updated all in game billboards to have fake Erebus Corp ads.
[*] Temporarily disabled squads to focus on a more polished FFA mode. New squads mode coming soon.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players were invisible in private zones.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could spawn in the elevator roof.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could bring guns into main lobby area.
[*] Fixed a bug where everyone's gun could vibrate on one players reload.
[*] Fixed a bug where ziplines would hit a stop point before ending.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong ambient SFX would play in the lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where players magazines would float around them.
[*] Fixed a bug where Sam the Robot would not talk to you.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Alpha skin would not appear in the private lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where skin selection would not work.
[*] Fixed a bug where push reload was not working on magazines.
[*] Fixed a bug where bots would not kill each other.
[*] Fixed a bug where front hand grip animation would pop open relentlessly.
[*] Fixed a bug where solo victory achievements were not getting unlocked on steam.
[*] Fixed a bug where players name tags would appear at some point after they land.
[*] Fixed a bug where dying from a fall would not register your death to other players.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not grab grenades from your backpack.
[*] Fixed a bug where it looked like other players were gripping in the wrong location of guns.
[*] Fixed a bug where your front hand would break if you held a gun with two hands and then release your front hand very far away from the gun.
[*] Fixed a bug where hitting join match sometimes took multiple clicks.
[*] Fixed a bug where a forced reload could occur by bringing a second weapon close to its magazine.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where you could get teleported back into the helicopter and die instantly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get multiple victories on a single victory.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not invite friends into your lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where victory / death music was not tied to music volume.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game was not ending for some players.
[*] Fixed a bug where the backpack held animations were off.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game could hard freeze for multiple people at once.
[*] Fixed a bug where bots would not die for some players.
[/list]


[b]Game Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Added aggressive occlusion culling, loding, and static batching methods that improved performance in high density locations like Sandford, Asylum and Warehouse district
[*] Optimized object poolers by disabling meshes of all objects not currently in use.
[*] Improved performance of AI drastically by switching from collision to distance checks for player search functions
[*] Improved performance of UI by replacing Unity Canvases with custom shaders.
[/list]

A reminder not to forget to catch us on our twitch stream tonight too: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr]https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr[/url]

See you on the battlefield [b]warriors![/b]

notes.title: Virtual Battlegrounds - Spooky Update - Mid Season Update
notes.content:
Hello [b]Warriors![/b]

Welcome to our biggest update since the start of Season 1! It's EA - Racoon 0.7.2.0. On top of our limited time spooky update this week we're also releasing our mid season update. This comes with a lot of quality of life improvements, bug fixes and a few new features. We'll share it all in this post.


[h2]New Parachute[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/g8obRg88FUpRSthbn3/giphy.gif[/img]

A lot of you asked for it and now you've got it! We've got a new physically controlled parachute in the game. You now how to pull your  chute and control it by gripping the left and right handles. Make sure you pull the chute or you'll splat!

[h2]Revolving Game Modes[/h2]

[previewyoutube=VzSXXJqR-6I;full][/previewyoutube]

Starting with our spooky game mode this week. We're planning on releasing new revolving game modes every week for the rest of the holiday season! With the exception of the spooky event this week game modes will only be available during limited time windows. Usually just during our events over the weekend. So make sure to drop in during those times to get in on the action!

Some more[b] game modes [/b]we have planned incoming.
[list]
[*] Floor is lava.
[*] Zombies.
[*] Juggernaut.
[*] Knives + Nades.
[*] And your ideas!
[/list]


[h2]Season One is Ending Soon[/h2]

Reminder Season One is coming to an end by December 1st! Make sure to achieve the warrior rank to unlock the warrior skin for S1 and the legend rank for the legend skin! This is the ONLY opportunity you'll receive to unlock these skins.

[h3][b]Warrior Skin[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/b6101d4df93f38d37227cdb23324532a34f81a98.png[/img]

Achieve warrior before the end of the season to unlock this skin.

[h3][b]Legend Skin[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/0c76e118c74e33a29c2adcc8640033c784e206f4.png[/img]

[b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/8b751dc2032f0f361579cb7d57137571ef60cedc.png[/img][/b]

[h3]Who will become [b]legend?[/b][/h3]

Achieve legend before the end of the season to unlock this skin.


[h3]Pumpkin Man Skin[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hWWHOpLoa6zqeoBHXW/giphy.gif[/img]

Also hop in and play at least one match during the Halloween event to unlock the pumpkin man skin!


[h2]Full[b] EA Raccoon 0.7.2[/b] Update List[/h2]


[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Parachute System
[*] Added weekly revolving game modes.
[*] Added hit direction visuals.
[*] Added kill distance on kills.
[*] Added new wristwatch.
[*] Added pumpkin man skin.
[/list]


[b]Quality of life improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added ability to mute specific members in your squad.
[*] Moved achievement unlocks over to our cloud save system.
[*] Lots of texture and asset updates.
[*] High texture quality settings now increase visual fidelity even further.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where glass would break when walking past it.
[*] Fixed a bug where gunstock settings would not properly save.
[*] Fixed a bug where M4 recoil would bounce.
[*] Fixed a bug where backpack would get stuck to your hand.
[*] Fixed a bug where players would not win the game with 2 players left.
[*] Fixed a bug where dropping the gun while holding the front gun could break it.
[*] Fixed a bug where gunfire VFX would not follow the gun.
[*] Fixed a bug where Oculus HMD was not getting the full 360 degrees of input.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could the see the UI skin selection while loading.
[*] Fixed a bug where some silencer SFX were not networked.
[*] Fixed a bug where directional movement would slow down based on hand angles when moving.
[*] Fixed a bug where players were painfully ejected when the helicopter reached its end destination.
[*] Fixed a bug where gunstock setting rotations past certain angles would begin to wig out.
[*] Fixed several stat progression bugs for kills on bots.
[*] Fixed crazy fast feet animation in helicopter.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could hear other people grab their guns.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could clip through the lighthouse.
[/list]


[h2]Weekend Spooky Events[/h2]
Lastly make sure to register on Challonge for the events we're hosting this weekend. We're aiming to pack the lobbies!

[h3]Friday 6PM EST: [url=https://challonge.com/events/vbgspookyfriday]Register here[/url]

notes.title: Spooky Update - Holiday Season Plans - Season 2 Information
notes.content:
Hello [b]Warriors![/b]

It's been a couple of months since we've given you an update so we wanted to fill you in.

We've got two of our biggest updates to date coming up soon. Number one is our spooky update which will release during the last week of October and number two is our season two update which will release in late November or early December. The season 2 update will be by far our biggest update to date!

[h2]Spooky Update[/h2]

[previewyoutube=A46y50P4VSE;full][/previewyoutube]

We promised you a "Mid Season Update" last time we spoke, unfortunately we were not able to finish it during September like we had planned. Instead we'll be releasing it with our "Spooky Update" at the end of the month. This update will feature everything planned for our mid season update like a new lobby and queue system a plethora of bug fixes, a few new minor features like physically controlled parachutes as well as a new spooky game mode. ːsteamhappyː


[h2]Holiday Season / Marketing Plans[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/723f61a3b66108678e9de05b66f9b8a0a245db02.png[/img]

Alright warriors it's about time we start getting players back into VBG. Once we rollout this big update at the end of the month the team is going to turn on its marketing gears again. Our goal is to fill up lobbies again by the end of the year. First though we needed to get the game to a more polished state and fix some of the critical issues, now that we're feeling those core issues have been mostly fixed we feel comfortable spreading the good word that VBG is back again. So how are we going to do this?

[list]
[*][b]Weekly Events[/b] - Every week we're going to be hosting several events at the start of November. Not only that but [b]EVERY WEEK[/b] we'll be dropping a BRAND NEW game mode during these events.

[*][b]Weekly Dev Streams [/b]- We want to keep you guys in the loop with what we're doing starting today and every week until the end of the year CyberDream will be hosting a 30 minute dev stream from 5:00 - 5:30PM EST. Catch us later on youtube if you miss us live or join us to ask us Q and A.

notes.title: EA Patch 0.6.9.0 (Cat) + State of VBG Update
notes.content:
Hello [b]Warriors![/b]

There's a few different things we want to go over with you today. First is the current state of VBG with the player counts, second is a very quick overview of our immediately planned updates as well as the season two update we have planned. And lastly is the patch itself. If you only want the patch notes scroll down until you see the cat!


[h2]Current State of VBG[/h2]
First off we want to thank you all for your continued support of Virtual Battlegrounds. Our team is still very excited for the future of VBG. We're aware that player counts are low right now but we're confident we can bolster player numbers again. We have a lot of quality of life and game play improvements planned for Virtual Battlegrounds and once they're in place we'll begin our marketing efforts again. Our goal has not changed from making the best VR Battle Royale that we can.

[h2]Next Steps[/h2]

[h3]Mid Season Update[/h3]
We have one more major update planned for Season One. This will be our biggest update for the season and we're calling it our "Mid Season Update". This will feature some major reworks of the lobby system, improved AI and even more stability and performance improvements to the game. Our hope for this patch is to make it more accessible for new players and to make it easier to player without other players.

[h3]Spooky Update[/h3]
Sometime in October we'll release something spooky ;D. No spoilers so more on this later.

[h3]Season Two[/h3]
After this update in October our updates will slow down until our season 2 update in November. This will be by far the single largest update we've introduced into Virtual Battlegrounds.  This will also be our biggest marketing effort since release week. If we're really going to reinvigorate our player numbers it will be during this time and possibly the spooky update too.


[h2]EA Patch 0.6.9.0 (Cat) [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/4528b6b040dca34042dd095ab9e4c2d5d4578ce1.gif[/img]

Alright guys on to the patch! Again the goal of this patch as similar to last one was purely stability and performance improvements. We actually made some major headway here this patch. We're finally feeling comfortable enough to begin adding content back into Virtual Battlegrounds again after this patch. Expect some new stuff from us in the next one.


[h2]Texture Streaming[/h2]
One of the big issues we've had with Virtual Battlegrounds is the sheer amount of VRAM and RAM the game required to run. This wasn't much of an issue for those of you with very high end machines but the average VR user was being pretty heavily affected. Long story short we managed to reduce the memory requirements for the game by 50%. This should result in less crashing, better performance and overall a more stable experience.

[h2]Visual Updates[/h2]
While optimizing our game assets we've been taking a look at the visual fidelity of various assets and updating the ones that were especially low quality. Here are a few assets updated this patch. Expect more visual updates over the next few patches.

[h3]New Bridge[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/c2d2aa40076daa5da17395e548d51673194561b9.png[/img]

[h3]New Ladders[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/9856a236691c8beb7b30b2bca7019c2185f14a68.png[/img]

[h3]New Gas Station
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/8a51646fcb09cb348474148fd861fb10740c633c.png[/img]

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
Again expect more performance improvements this patch thanks to the texture streaming and physics optimizations we built into this patch. Mileage will vary but we've seen numbers from 5-30% gains for players.

[h2]More Music[/h2]
Integrated some music into our JukeBox from one of our players Mekugi! Check it out in the lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/04ee484042eb767ce9af821571177a05202fc543.jpg[/img]

Check out his music here: [url=https://soundcloud.com/mekugiofficial]https://soundcloud.com/mekugiofficial[/url]

[h2]Full Notes[/h2]
Honestly warriors most of the stuff we've done this patch is going to be in the list below. As our goal was primarily stability and performance for this update this had us going through the many bugs that users have found over the last few months and tackling them one at a time. We've got more to go but the list is shrinking.

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an underwater breathing mechanic (players can now drown)
[*] Added a new zipline system that replaced the old one. (functionally very similar but less buggy)
[/list]

[b]Design Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Made apples heal you overtime instead of instantly (limit exploitative healing tactics during combat).
[*] Increased height of doors on generic houses by another 6 inches. (For you tall folk)
[*] Made it so you could shoot through fences.
[*] Made the bell ring when you shoot it.
[*] Made it so you can see the helicopter trail on the map when in the helicopter.
[*] Made bots drop in a bit earlier. Should be roughly the same time as the players drop in.
[*] Changed press space to hold grip on the credits screen to open up the credits.
[*] Added an option to crouch while standing with a button.
[*] Added air drop SFX to make it more apparent.
[/list]


[b]Major Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed jumping without air control exploit. (Forever Jump)
[*] Fixed gun angles flipping up when players got kills.
[*] Fixed not being able to put anything in backpack until you hold it once.
[*] Fixed zipline not working in the tutorial area.
[/list]

[b]Minor Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed loot in some cabinets not being grab able in Sandford.
[*] Fixed broken terrain geometry near Sandford.
[*] Fixed clipping through tractor body in Maetland.
[*] Fixed clipping through boulders on the south side of the island near Motel.
[*] Fixed first gunshot lagging the game.
[*] Fixed Alpha skin not popping up in the lobby.
[*] Fixed ziplines in water area near shoreline not working.
[*] Fixed roads in Sandford not playing SFX.
[*] Fixed weapons from other players not pointing the direction they're aiming.
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Suspected Fix[/b] | Things we think we fixed but we need your help confirming
The dreaded scope bug. (You know the one)

And we're going live now at https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr to discuss our next steps for Virtual Battlegrounds.

See you on the battlefield warriors!

notes.title: Alpha Patch 0.6.7.0 (Squirrel) Stability Update
notes.content:
Hello [b]Warriors![/b]

Big stability patch coming today. After rushing to get season one out we decided to buckle down and focus on bug fixing and performance for our next update. We know that VBG while at it's core has been fun it hasn't been without its issues. This patch should tighten up a lot of those issues. More fixes coming soon.


[h1]Full list of patch notes.[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] BHaptics Suit Integration
[/list]


[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved kill trading. Should be much less likely to occur, we found an issue in the code that made it twice as likely to occur as it should have been.
[*] Directional icon on map for helicopter trajectory.
[*] Double the points for winning / losing in ranked games. Should make for faster ranking up.
[*] Game uses about 15% less memory.
[*] Slight CPU performance increases. More coming soon.
[*] Visual improvements to the ladders.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]We've confirmed fixed these internally[/b]
[*] Fixed end game card showing victory when you've lost.
[*] Fixed scopes on guns dissapearing.
[*] Fixed receiving victory before landing in solo games
[*] Fixed crashing on lower end GPUs on game launch.
[*] Fixed m4/m16 recoil
[*] Fixed click sfx when pulling right trigger.
[*] Fixed leveling not working
[*] Fixed shoulder disjointed on marines.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could become invulnerable before game ends.
[*] Fixed stat progressions getting stuck
[*] Fixed physics based wall throwing
[*] Fixed grenades not giving kill credit
[*] Fixed grenade launcher not giving kill credit
[*] Fixed terrain holes around road network in sandford
[*] Fixed glitches with menu UI sliders
[*] Fixed bad collision on underwater sand
[*] Fixed visible ghost players flying around after death and shooting
[*] Fixed being able to bring a gun into the main lobby area
[*] Fixed not receiving score in some ranked games
[*] Fixed airdrop sometimes not dropping drops inside of zone
[*] Fixed AI not dying from grenades sometimes
[*] Fixed spawning air drops in the pre match lobby
[*] Fixed apples sometimes getting stuck in your hand
[*] Fixed holding a gun on death
[*] Fixed getting a victory in single player games before bots spawn in some cases.
[*] Fixed deagle breaking when switching firing modes
[*] Fixed five seven breaking when switching firing modes
[*] Fixed sandford hole in terrain near the bridge
[*] Fixed map not turning on wrist when angled away from player

[*] [b]We suspect we fixed these: (Need help confirming)[/b]
[*] Suspected fix hand staying open animated while holding a gun
[*] Suspected fix end game card showing victory when you've lost in some squad games
[*] Suspected fix gun calibration not saving in some cases

[/list]

[h2]Player Counts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/65bc0a9b0aa978aa20770a1582610575481bd1d2.jpg[/img]

We know the player counts have dropped a lot. It sucks but we're not giving up on the game anytime soon. In fact it's just the opposite, we're more motivated now then ever to make VBG an awesome game. We're going to start doing weekly events and continue pushing out updates regularly. We believe that VBG can be a top VR Battle Royale and get constant full lobbies again! But we're going to need your help to spread the word. If you're having fun playing VBG tell your friends. We'll plan on doing some free weekends in the future too.

Furthermore we have plans to make the game more fun and easier to play with less players too. Bots will be smarter and dropping into matches will be much quicker. No more waiting in the lobby for 5-10 minutes for games. More on that when we drop the next patch.

[h2]Play with the Devs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/dc53ad797d2df5652834edd2f5fcf362b7d3473f.jpg[/img]

We're doing a play with the devs event this Saturday at 1PM EST. Come in, squad up, shoot us down or whatever! We meant it when we said see you on the battlefield :D.


[h2]Twitch Stream[/h2]

As usual we're doing a twitch stream with our updates at 5PM EST today (now if this is just going live). We'll be talking about our plans for the next update, events, player counts, and answering any QA. We're also going to start saving our streams on our youtube channel so you can catch up on them the following week.


[h2][url=https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr]https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr
[/url][/h2]

Hello [b]Warriors! [/b]


It's finally time to drop our first [b]major update! [/b] Welcome to [b]Season One.[/b]

[h2]Season One[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/8d584c5e53a6c64625a36c9ac2f39e7ce123b612.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/bacbfbde67f5971edbf4c72a3c8d5486a464b485.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ranking[/h2]

[b]Hybrid Elo System: [/b] The ELO system wasn't working very well for VBG. The game being a battle royale and not having a large enough player base to do competitive matchmaking made for a system that wasn't very reliable, fair, or forgiving especially for players with very high elo. Instead we've opted in for a new system that combines a traditional point system with an elo system. We're calling it our hybrid elo system. 

[b]New Rankings:[/b] With the hybrid elo system we've also shipped out new rankings to make ranking up more fun. Now you can flash your ranked emblems around proudly. Way cooler then an arbitrary number.

[list]
[*] [b]Recruit[/b] - Bronze equivalent
[*] [b]Veteran[/b] - Silver equivalent
[*] [b]Warrior[/b] - Gold equivalent
[*] [b]Elite [/b]- Platinum equivalent
[*] [b]Hero[/b] - Diamond equivalent
[*] [b]Master[/b] - Masters equivalent
[*] [b]Legend [/b]- Challenger equivalent
[/list]

[b]How to get it: [/b]The skin can only be unlocked by placing in the Warrior League by the end of the season. It's the equivalent for Gold in most other competitive games so it will be difficult to unlock but most players who play VBG regularly will be able to unlock it.


[h2]Sandford[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/7d634088d66231fb3d5f1d28105b4560d55e3619.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/27f4a1330cbe5c04c21960c9d476f94f6ad0ad32.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to Sanford: [/b] The new location inside of Virtual Battlegrounds. 

[b]More Information:[/b] It features apartment complexes, bars, a shopping plaza, small gardens, a town hall, and some mid sized town homes. 

[b]Going Forward: [/b]Technically Sandford is actually a complete overhaul of what was Maetland main. notes.title: Virtual Battlegrounds (EA Patch 0.6.4.0 BullFrog)
notes.content:
Hello [b]Warriors![/b]

It's finally time for us to exit the insect kingdom and make our way to the ultimate bug hunter the BullFrog!


Here's our patch history since January this year.
[list]
[*] [b]Alpha Black Ant ->[/b] Physics Jumping, ProTube Support, Dynamic Lighting
[*] [b]Alpha Fire Ant -> [/b] Underwater VFX / Swimming, Landscape rendering, Basketball Mini Game
[*] [b]Alpha Lightning Bug - > [/b] Tutorial, Voice Overs, Bots, Steam Friends Invite
[*] [b]Alpha Tarantula -> [/b]Squads Mode, Ballistics, Credits Screen, Youtube Player in Game
[*] [b]EA Mantis ->[/b] Gun Range, Melee Weapons, Killroom, Helicopters rework
[*] [b]EA Bull Frog ->[/b] Improved Loading times, Performance Optimizations, and better inventory management.
[/list]


The big focus for this patch has been [b]performance improvements, loading times and better inventory management.[/b] We've heard everyone's complaints and we've worked rigorously the past two weeks to make Virtual Battlegrounds more accessible. 

[h2]Improved Loading Times[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/1a5812a0224925e28b5281cce72e288a89d2dbef.png[/img]

We know this isn't the most exciting "feature" for most of you but it was a huge technical accomplishment for our team and it was our biggest focus this patch. 

Now the entire game loads into ram at game start. Once the initial load is finished hopping in and out of a match is easy. Expect between 5-10 seconds of load time between matches whether or not you're on an SSD or HDD! We even added a replay button that pops up after matches so you can quickly hop back into another game.

[h2]Floating Backpack Option[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ktlHCS0.gif[/img]

One of the big complaints we've heard people say during the course of Early Access is the difficulty of using their backpack and equipment. We've done a few things including adding the option of a floating backpack to make their gameplay more fluid. Additionally we've prioritized grabbing items off of the players body over items on the ground and walls. We've had several users complain they are having trouble putting things on and off their body. Lastly we've also increased the range at which items can grab and snap back to your body. We're curious to see what you all think.

[h2]Season One[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/0cd0e041776dd89eb87594f316153c98ecb1bb28.jpg[/img]

With BullFrog starting now that means it's getting closer for us to start season one. Once we've polished the game some more this month we're going to drop a big update next month to start season one. Get ready!

The votes are in and here are our plans we've got for [b]season one! [/b]
[list]
[*] More guns
[*] Grenades
[*] New Map location
[*] Air Drops
[*] Downed Squad Mates
[*] Unlockable Skins
[*] Tournaments / Events
[/list]

We'll update the voting board once season one drops.

Reminder to that at the end of each season the top 10 squads / ranked players will all receive a special skin. The top 20-30% of players will also receive a special skin.

[h2]The Future[/h2]

Lastly a few people seemed to doubt us when we showed that screenshot of our long term goal for the map. So here's some actual first person footage from atop of Mount Ostenbirk of what that terrain might end up looking like.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QQjojF4.gif[/img]

[h2]Complete Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebuilt loading system. Game all gets loaded into ram on launch and stays in ram. Can hop in and out of matches in about 5-10 seconds whether or not you're on an SSD or HDD.
[*] Added a replay game button as well to make hopping back into matches quick and easy. 
[*] New option to allow backpack to float in front of you when you release it. Ideally this should make backpacks easier to use with attachments. 
[/list]


[b]Design Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Jukebox shuffles playlist on load. RIP YUKI.
[*] Suppressors now add 5% increased meters per second velocity and 5% increased damage.
[*] Reduced audio range of zip-lines from 150M -> 100M.
[*] Pistols can now use holo + red dot sights.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements across the board. 30% gains. 
[*] STEAMVR throwing physics improved.
[*] Backpack should be easier to grab in crouch, prone and standing states.
[*] Weapon spawns should be more consistent. Need more verification on this from users.
[*] Can see total number of players in lobby.
[*] Can grab backpack items by pointing at them or putting your hand over them.
[*] Made it easier to grab and remove stuff from your body / belt.
[*] Made the belt / body items a higher priority for grabbing then walls and things on the floor.
[*] More consistent leader-board results.
[*] More consistent weapon spawning.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to see 4 digit rankings on leader-boards in lobby.
[*] Fixed 3rd squad-mate icon being off.
[*] Fixed helicopters sometimes freezing in the sky.
[*] Fixed the guns UI, BELTUI, and left / right eye render not saving between scenes.
[*] Less black screening between matches.
[*] Should see ELO changes taking place more consistently now. You can also lose elo now. Buckle up everyone above 2K.
[/list]

[b]New known issues that will be resolved soon.[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons floating above their spawn points occasionally
[*] Temporarily disabled tutorial
[/list]

Lastly, we have a stream planned for tonight 5/8/2/2020 at 7PM EST! We'll upload the video here afterwords in case you miss it.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/cyberdreamvr][h2]CyberDream Dev Stream 7PM EST [/h2][/url]


See you on the battlefield soon [b]warriors![/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/e2dc849a8821198233a4c3401f329c3387e27017.png[/img]

Hello warriors!

[b]This post.[/b]
We want to go over two things with you today #1 our plans for EA, seasons, vehicles, more guns, more map locations, tournaments etc! And #2 talk about our patch today and review launch week.

[b]To the people that had bugs/fps issues on launch week.[/b]
To be frank, we dropped with a lot more new and unexpected issues. We want to sincerely apologize to anyone that experienced any major bugs or performance issues during launch week. But there's good news! We've DEMOLISHED a ton of the bugs and performance issues people have been reporting and we also fixed a bunch of player exploits like levitating and wall clipping. Honestly without the support from everyone during EA though critical and positive it would have been so much harder for us to make the huge strides we did this week. It's obvious people love the core of our game. We only expect to go up from here.

Here's a full list of performance fixes, bug fixes, and new features we've added since last weds.

[b]==Performance Fixes==[/b]
[list]
[*]Substantially decreased net lag
[*]Significantly Increased performance for all steamVR users
[*]Performance improvements in matches with a high number of players
[*]GC Allocation improvements to reduce memory usage over time
[*]Better Error handling and logging in key places
[*]Spent magazines are now being properly destroyed to reduce resource usage
[*]Performance fixes related to certain objects not setting properly on game start resulting in issues with main game play loop
[*]There's still a remaining "stuttering" issue we've noticed affects something like 1/20 players. We plan on having this resolved ASAP.
[/list]


[b]==General Fixes==[/b]
[list]
[*]Players are less likely to spawn outside of the helicopter
[*]Fixed black screen load bug when spawning in the helicopter
[*]Fixed exploit where players could bring weapons into the helicopter from killroom
[*]Weapons are more likely to spawn
[*]Fixed an exploit for becoming a spectator before the game started
[*]Fixed an exploit for artificially increasing your height making you levitate
[*]Fixed 4 digit leader board numbers not displaying properly
[*]Fixed an exploit where users could artificially increase there rank
[*]Fixed a bug where players would start the game in a swimming state
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would not start and a lobby would break
[*]Fixed a bug where head IK's were looking down
[*]Fixed a bug where mag / pistols get moved when adjusting height
[*]Fixed jukebox in pre-match lobby
[*]Fixed VFX lagging behind guns
[*]Fixed LIV not working for some players
[*]Fixed voting board not visually updating properly
[*]Fixed a bug where voting board would say squads mode when it was actually in solos mode
[*]Fixed a bug where players could become invincible at the end of a match
[*]Fixed bug where rank would be off by one
[*]Fixed exploit where users get multiple victories in one victory giving them outrageous scores
[*]Fix body moving exploit from climbing to not climbing to prevent people leaving helicopter early
[*]Fix displaying wrong rank
[*]Added golden skin
[*]Fixed swimming not working properly
[*]Apples now get fully eaten when you bite them
[*]Fixed icons above everyone heads when pre-joining
[*]Fixed a bug where people were looking at you while there IK's animated looking the other way
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing people's pelvis to feel off center.
[*]Fixed Throwing Knives, now deal damage
[*]Fixed being able to accidentally stab yourself with a knife
[*]Fixed Knife not being able to damage bots and target dummies
[/list]

[b]==Design Changes==[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the distance that ziplines can be heard from (200m -> 100m)
[*]Reduced the distance that breakable glass can be heard from (150m -> 75m)
[*]Seated mode movement repositioning now lerps (This also fixes some clipping exploits)
[*]Made it easier to grab your backpack and holster items especially when crouching
[*]Increased knife damage from RANGE (25-100) to -> (35-100). It deals more damage based on how fast you swing.
[*]Increased Knife minimum damage from (25-100) to (35-100). 
[*]Knife deals damage based on how fast the player swings
[*]Updated the visuals of the zone.
[*]Made it easier to grab items off your body
[/list]

Additionally we wanted to share with you the core weapon stats and player stats so that you guys have a point of reference going forward. NOTE we will be balancing all of these in the future.

[b]==Wiki Notes==[/b]

All weapons have a minimum amount of damage they deal and then they begin to lose damage as the projectiles closes in on its effective range up to a minimum amount. This distance is varied a lot from gun to gun.

[*]Added Version mismatch check. Players on different versions can no longer join each other

[*]Added smooth lerping to seated mode
[/list]

[h1]Road Map[/h1]
Now for the fun part! We have a ton of stuff planned guys. Please view our FULL roadmap online here.

https://trello.com/b/kvO0EmYl/virtual-battlegrounds-roadmap

[olist]
The immediate stuff

[*][b]Performance[/b]
While we feel confident that we have improved performance across the board since launch. Our primary concern is making sure that a majority if not all performance issues are addressed before we begin work on adding new content. We want to make sure that all players are able to enjoy the game and bring them along so they don't miss the launch of major updates due to performance issues.

[*][b]Load Times[/b]
Following performance fixes, we will follow that up with streamlining the game to improve load times.  We have an idea that should virtually reduce all load times down to a couple of seconds after the first load into the "Robot Lobby" Creating a seamless experience making it really easy to replay games quickly and easily regardless if you're on an HDD or SSD.

[*][b]Grenades and more weapons[/b]
Our first new weapon to be added to the game will take the form of grenades. This will make for more indirect ways for taking out players that are using cover or in hard to approach areas.

[*][b]More Weapons[/b]
Details to be announced soon. We don't wait to spoil it until you guys see it.

[*][b]Season One[/b]
Here's the really BIG thing we'll be doing. And we'll be doing seasonal updates regularly as the game progresses toward exiting EA. With Season One we'll be resetting the leaderboard and pushing for a competitive season. 
[/olist]

The votes are in! And here is our current roadmap.

[h2]Season One Features[/h2] 
[*]More Weapons
[*]Air Drops
[*]Unlock-able Skins based on level.
[*]New revised map locations
[*]Physics based climb jumping
[*]More realistic bots
[*]Down State for squadmates
[*]More finger gestures
[*]Top 10 players in solos and squads will each receive a special "Top Ranking skin" for there respective division at the end of the season.
[*]Top 20% of players will receive a special "high achiever skin" at the end of the season.


[h2]Guaranteed Features[/h2]
[*]Vehicles
[*]More guns
[*]Improved VRIK
[*]Ragdolls
[*]Game Modes
[*]Better Achievements
[*]Enhanced Map
[*]More seasons


[h2]Stuff we might add[/h2]
[*]More Drones
[*]Armor
[*]Modding Support
[*]New Maps
[*]Nighttime mode
[*]Tournaments / Events
[*]Quest Support
[*]Your ideas! Join our Discord and tell them them to us.
[/list]

Just to give you guys an idea of how serious we are take a look at this.

Here's our map as it is today. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/6efb5e636810f86fee567c62fcba8d7bbb992ad1.png[/img]

And here's the map we had planned to use for VBG. It's several times larger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/83acff67976c23835d030800fd7bb35008dd912c.png[/img]

We chose to go with the first map not because we wanted to go small persay but because the larger map wasn't as "fun" with 20~ players. People spent most of there time searching for other people instead of battling, it created a pretty dull experience that involved a lot of wait time. But damn was it cool to look around and see that giant world.

We're not promising this BUT we do want to go bigger, and really the only way to go bigger is to get more players and improve the games core. We know our game is early right now, we know it needs a lot of work but the foundation is there and it's fun as is. There isn't a better way for us to make this a 100 person VR battle royale game one day then to work with our community in EA in our opinion. That's what we're doing now.  Like I said we can't promise that it really depends on how the future goes but I promise we'll try our best to make that a reality.

[h3]We're going over roadmap on Twitch now! Ask us anything![/h3]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/seanybaby2][h2]
Seanybaby2 Twitch Stream[/h2][/url]

[b]See you on the battlefield soon warriors![/b]

notes.title: Virtual Battlegrounds Status Update
notes.content:
We’ve been through the 36 hour Open Beta and made some great memories here with the first large scale event for Virtual Battlegrounds.  The last VICTORY was won, the lights went dim, and the Virtual Battlegrounds Open Beta comes to a close… with ragesaq still on the server.

The feedback was immeasurably valuable, those who joined us in Discord can already see the bug fixes, tweaks added, and improvements made in rapid succession during this event.

And with that being said  I have some unfortunate news. Because of the current situation with this pandemic some of our partners are working from home and have been unable to complete some required steps that have to be done before we’re able to release tomorrow.

Because of that we have to postpone our release date until further notice. ATM our target is April 15th, we believe that this date is attainable but it's currently out of our hands. If things go well we can possibly release sooner.

The week post-launch, we scheduled a rapid bug fixing sprint, and this will continue as scheduled, it's just been spread out through a two week period. Within a week of launch we'll be back on our schedule for Early Access development, we'll be hunkered down at home working on the game.

Thank you for your patience Warriors. We look forward to seeing you all on the battlefield again soon.

In the meantime you can watch some of our friends playing the game from the event!

notes.title: Virtual Battlegrounds - Alpha 0.5.8 (Lightning Bug) Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/97051e74db2065a57e748a39b452a1442dc76fe4.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Warriors![/b]

Welcome to the [b]Alpha 0.5.8.0 Lightning[/b] Bug Update!

Since our last post we've had two major updates. [b]Alpha 0.5.7.0 (Fire Ant)[/b] and now [b]Alpha 0.5.8.0 (Lightning Bug)[/b]. With those updates came a host of big and small new features and a ton of bug fixes. We won't be going over everything that's changed because the list is quite long but we'll be highlighting some of the biggest updates.

[i]Sign up for the future Alphas! [url=http://eepurl.com/gPRL6T]http://eepurl.com/gPRL6T[/url][/i]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/f1baa53a0290d8c09081db48d404588347ceac2d.png[/img]

One of the biggest problems we've noticed new users have when testing Virtual Battlegrounds is figuring out how to use the basic controls. That's why we've added in this fun new tutorial that loads up the first time anyone plays the game. It features Sam the robot. An AI companion that will be featured throughout the universe of Virtual Battlegrounds that is controlled by your robot overlords corporation Erebus. He enthusiastically teach you how to play VBG. While the tutorial is not done yet, we think it's off to a good start.


[h1]Bots[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/35ae475f6e615983161b091c2cea93871a32e9f1.jpg[/img]

We know that matches may not always be full and because of that having bots is critical to keeping a game alive in the VR space. So for this update we've added both a single player with bots option and bots mode option while in a multiplayer game.

[h1]Steam Friends Integration[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/ff926134b7eab98796ef4e6509ff1f6dabb28fca.png[/img]

Being able to play with your friends is super important, that's why we wanted to make it as easy possible. Invite your friends through a friends system that we built directly into the game that interfaces with Steam.

[h1]Squads Mode[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/1a3ae1c8c76056d08d9adc4e2de3e09671c215fe.jpg[/img]

We had planned to launch Squads mode for this update. We've tested it a bit intenrally and it's a ton of fun! Unfortunately we ran into a few problems with the mode and decided to wait to launch it in a hotfix before a future update. Look forward to that update coming soon!

[h1]Development Timeline Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32477840/4bfe8917d7b58c63af8801df947314e9a4e015cd.png[/img]

Reminder that you can view our development timeline at any time here:

[url=https://trello.com/b/kvO0EmYl/virtual-battlegrounds-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/kvO0EmYl/virtual-battlegrounds-roadmap[/url]

We've update our development timeline to reflect the changes we've made since our last update. The timeline is always changing!. We're considering adding in an in game Trello board that anyone can vote on, what do you think of this idea?

[h1]Full List of Notable Changes[/h1]
[b]New Features:[/b]
Added a tutorial.
Added bots into main game mode.
Added consumable pickups.
Added vegetation LOD system.
Added improved graphical settings.
Added Steam friends options.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed weapon muzzle flashes falling behind when moving quickly.
Fixed killing people in the helicopter before match starts.
Fixed getting stuck in a black screen when loading into a game.
Fixed odd collision on top of zipline towers.
Fixed mic muting options.
Fixed bot games breaking after first use.
Fixed sharing attachments with your team mates not working.
Fixed zipline audio not producing audio on the network.
Fixed bounding sphere moving rapidly before game starts on rare occasions.
Fixed not falling from zipline when dying on zipline.
Fixed swimming adding velocity to character after climbing.

[b]Design Improvements:[/b]
Made it easier to grab weapons on the ground.
Made it easier to drop weapons into your hip slots.
Increased end game menu size by 20% to make it more legible.
Increased average frame rate by 20%.
Improved several key game textures. (Rocks, Vegetation)

[h1]Alpha Invite Status[/h1]

We've invited an additional 250 people into our alpha.  The goal right now is to ramp up stress tests as much as possible while we ramp up for release. We plan on rolling out additional incremental invites on a weekly basis. If you haven't signed up for our alpha already make sure you do so [url=http://eepurl.com/dAL-kz]here! [/url] EVERYONE gets invited eventually


[b]Thanks for reading warriors! [/b] 

We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield soon

notes.title: Virtual Battlegrounds is set to release on March 15th! + Gameplay Footage
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello warriors and welcome to the launch of the ultimate VR Battle Royale.[/b][/h1]

Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SzZo9yDWDuo

We have noticed some of you have questions about gameplay. We decided to share with you some insight into our gameplay along with some gameplay footage.

[b]Gunplay:[/b] Gunplay has been critically important to us since the start of development. We wanted something that both felt real but also felt good. After a number of really good shooters released last year like Contractors and Zero Caliber we took inspiration from what things we liked and what things we didn't.
[url=https://imgur.com/a/Ffq8LTD]Gunplay Footage Rifles[/url] | Physics | Pistols| Scopes

[b]Locomotion:[/b] Locomotion has been one of the most challenging things to tackle well in VR and frankly we're still not happy with the majority of the solutions people are using for VR games now. Physicality has been a major driving motivator for a lot of our design decisions in regards to locomotion, we want people playing the game while standing and doing it as naturally as they do in real life. This game isn't meant to be played sitting down. Be prepared to sprint with your arms, swim, jump in real life, and climb with your arms. I'm biased but we think all of this makes for a much more fun and immersive experience.

[url=https://imgur.com/a/Gtr3eTf]Locomotion Footage [/url]| Jumping IRL | Swimming| Spriting



Locomotion cont: We also added in some fun ways to move around the map, because this is VR and VR should be better than real life.

[url=https://imgur.com/a/ScY9VOq]Locomotion cont Footage [/url]| Skydiving | Ziplining



[b]The World:[/b] When we first made our announcement we promised a 4 KM square map. Well, we made one and holy crap it was ginormous in VR. Like wa**aaay too big. Well now it's 2 square KM and it's still massive but not so big that it requires a workout every time you want to go somewhere. The large map size is part of why we added in so many fun ways to zip around the world to help counter balance the scale.

[url=https://imgur.com/a/uRoJrP3]Map Footage [/url]| The World | Maetland | Ostenbirk | Zipline Towers | The Church | The Aslyum |



[b]The Lobby:[/b] Waiting for a match should be fun, and because of the low player counts in VR sometimes this can take a while. This is why we have added in a ton of fun things to do when matchmaking.

[url=https://imgur.com/a/e7XbHLE]Lobby Footage [/url]| JukeBox | Real Settings Menus | Basketball | Gun Range | Skins



[b]Game Modes: [/b]We're currently supporting FFA and 4 person squads. We may add more stuff depending on what you guys want. We have also talked a bit about adding a game mode like infection from halo and cod zombies.



[b]Vehicles: [/b]You use both your arms to control vehicles naturally. No joystick locomotion.



[b]Bots:[/b] We have them, they aren't geniuses but they do the things and can help fill up a lobby.



[b]Number of Players: [/b] 24 currently. If this game is popular enough we are considering changing up our server architecture to support up to 100 or more, but for now 24 should be stable with the size of the VR market.

[url=https://discord.gg/jsyWfcS]Join us on Discord[/url]
